title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Deciding a Demurrage Dispute with a Credit
content:
## Scope

The desk decides disputes against demurrage lines of Demurrage and Detention Free Time records that are brought on the ground of misapplied rates or misapplied free time. Such a dispute is resolved from the records: the line is priced again, and where the invoice charged more than the repricing supports, the overcharge found is credited back against the line up to the limit the dispute rules set. The decision and the credit are recorded together.

## Recording the decision: `book_dispute_credit_515e844f`

A desk tool outside the default set: the agent has to unlock it, after which the agent calls it itself.

**Capability.** The tool writes one dispute credit entry, dated the day of booking, on the free-time record. The entry points at the disputed invoice line and at the dispute most recently lodged against that line, and the balance owed on the record goes down by the amount credited. The tool also records the decision on that dispute. It identifies the dispute from the invoice line alone — it takes whichever dispute against the line has the latest lodging time, whatever outcome that dispute shows at the moment — and the outcome supplied replaces the one it showed. The customer then sees the dispute as decided and the credit against the line.

**Parameters.**

| Name | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `dnd_id` | reference number of the free-time record carrying the disputed line, from the free-time record lookup | text |
| `invoice_event_id` | invoice reference of the disputed line, from the account entry lookup | text |
| `outcome` | the decision to record on the dispute | exactly one of the values below |
| `amount_usd` | the amount credited, in US dollars | positive, two decimals |

Values accepted for `outcome`:

- `upheld` — the credit equals the whole amount disputed;
- `partially_upheld` — a credit is given, smaller than the amount disputed;
- `denied` — the dispute fails and no credit would be due;
- `submitted` — the dispute remains undecided;
- `withdrawn` — the customer has taken the dispute back.

**Return.** Success is reported as "Dispute <dispute reference> decided <outcome>; credit <credit entry reference> of USD <amount> booked against invoice line <invoice_event_id> on record <dnd_id>; balance due now USD <balance>." The dispute reference is that of the latest dispute lodged against the line, shown as the word none if the line has no dispute; the balance is the record's outstanding amount after the credit, in US dollars to two decimals. A message that begins "Error:" tells the desk that no record exists under that reference and that nothing was booked.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Can the credit exceed the overcharge found on repricing?**
No. The credit is limited by the overcharge and by the dispute's own figure, as the dispute credit rules define.
